title: Sensei - Take Back The Night (Fresh Animations)
description: This is a Fresh Animations addon resource pack I made a few years ago. It features Sensei from CaptainSparklez's Fallen Kingdom.
body:
Fresh Animations asset(s) have been included and edited with permission from the creator, @FreshLX

Requires Optifine or equivalent

To get Sensei rename a desert librarian villager to "Sensei"

This pack might work in newer minecraft versions but I haven't tested it.

There's a Jappa version inside the pack folder.

Credits:
Take Back The Night by CaptainSparklez
Fresh Animations by FreshLX
